detail: Reading proposed choices leaves setup incomplete. Confirming the complete selection enables the app.
Browser Add to Inbox saves an exact Unicode Task without starting execution.
Renaming preserves the Task directory. The exact edited document remains stored.
A competing stale document save is rejected and preserves current content.
Repeating the same accepted capture returns its original Task.
Equal Unicode titles allocate distinct directories and preserve existing documents.
Project edits persist. A competing stale save cannot replace current content.
Archive preserves readable context and refuses edits. Reopen restores active state.
Complete stopped-home restore preserves passkey access, Task content, Project context, and model selections.
